name: online_code_editor
description: An online code editor is a web-based tool that allows users to write, edit, and run code directly in a browser. It typically consists of three main components: a text editor for code input, an area to display the output, and various controls or buttons to run or manipulate the code. Technology Stack used - HTML, CSS and JavaScript

paragraphs: An Online Code Editor built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that allows users to write, edit, and run code directly in their browser. This tool supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python. It provides a live HTML and CSS preview, making it easy to see changes in real-time. The editor also features syntax highlighting for a better coding experience.
features: Code Editor: Write code in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or Python directly in the browser ✍️
Live Preview: See real-time HTML and CSS changes as you write the code 🔄
Syntax Highlighting: Enhanced readability with color-coded syntax for different programming languages 🌈
Multi-Language Support: Supports HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python for versatile coding practices 🔠
